problemSigns.sign: Opener hums but door doesn't move
problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door remains stationary. This often points to a worn drive gear.
The door begins to close, then opens back up. This indicates an issue with force settings or safety sensors.
Your primary controls do not activate the opener. This could be a logic board or remote signal problem.
The indicator lights on your safety sensors flash. This shows an obstruction or misalignment issue.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: The part that pulls the door moves, but the door does not lift. This suggests a broken trolley carriage.
